agents.name: Scope Facilitator
agents.role: Turns ambiguity into an auditable scope

agents.name: Evidence Curator
agents.role: Finds, ranks, and reconciles source records

agents.name: Finding Challenger
agents.role: Tests signals and drafts reviewable findings

agents.name: Readiness Facilitator
agents.role: Assembles facts into a report disposition

skills.name: Scope framing interview
skills.purpose: Turn an audit request into a bounded, reviewable scope with explicit accountability.
skills.humanGate: Audit lead confirms scope and accountable owner.
skills.completionSignal: Scope anchor, control families, risk rationale, and accountable owner are present.

skills.name: Evidence intake coach
skills.purpose: Guide an employee through evidence retrieval without hiding freshness, provenance, or gaps.
skills.humanGate: Evidence owner confirms that the source set is complete enough to review.
skills.completionSignal: Source set, effective-date window, freshness, and evidence gaps are recorded.

skills.name: Genealogy trace guide
skills.purpose: Walk the employee through upstream and downstream links until each conclusion has a defensible path.
skills.humanGate: Quality reviewer accepts the trace boundary and unresolved edges.
skills.completionSignal: Anchor, traversal direction, direct relationships, and unresolved edges are visible.

skills.name: Finding challenge dialogue
skills.purpose: Help an employee challenge a signal before drafting a finding and preserve the reasoning trail.
skills.humanGate: Accountable audit lead approves severity, wording, and owner before issue.
skills.completionSignal: Signal, counter-evidence test, provisional severity, rationale, and owner are captured.

skills.name: Readiness review facilitator
skills.purpose: Prepare a reportable readiness position while clearly separating facts, recommendations, and human decisions.
skills.humanGate: Audit lead and quality approver accept the report disposition.
skills.completionSignal: Readiness position, action list, approver, and report disposition are explicit.

phases.label: 1. Frame the audit
phases.description: Set the boundary, accountable roles, standard, and risk lens.

phases.label: 2. Pull evidence
phases.description: Gather source records, test freshness, and identify missing joins.

phases.label: 3. Trace the chain
phases.description: Walk product, requirement, supplier, change, and person relationships.

phases.label: 4. Evaluate findings
phases.description: Challenge signals, draft findings, and preserve rationale.

phases.label: 5. Review & close
phases.description: Prepare the readiness report and route decisions for approval.
